english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for help or assistance that makes something more effective.
Use this for the general notion of help, especially in more formal or abstract phrasing.

examples.english: This new feature is a big boost to efficiency.
examples.traditional: 呢個新功能對提升效率好有幫助。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 san1 gung1 nang4 deoi3 tai4 sing1 haau6 leot6 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6

examples.english: Reading provides great assistance for learning Chinese.
examples.traditional: 閱讀對學習中文好有幫助。
examples.jyutping: jyut6 duk6 deoi3 hok6 zaap6 zung1 man4 hou2 jau5 bong1 zo6
